core_obligations: Build the ideal J of the complement of U x V from the box of the boundary ideals; V(J) is exactly the complement.
A power of J maps to F hitting any prescribed section; resolutions of the boundary ideals give box-product surjections.
Finite affine cover and finite sections assemble the global surjection; direct sums of the tensor powers give E and G.
proof_roadmap: Construct J locally, hit the sections, then assemble globally.
difficulty_reason: Ideal sheaf construction with a section-by-section assembly; fully displayed.
